preconditions.description: Must be the contract owner to call changeFees() function
Contract must not be in swap state (inSwap == false)

exploit_hint: Call changeFees() with parameters that set totalFeeBuy or totalFeeSell to zero, then trigger a transfer that calls takeFeeInProportions() where division by totalFeeBuy or totalFeeSell will occur. Specifically, set reflectionFeeBuy, marketingFeeBuy, and teamFeeBuy all to zero to make totalFeeBuy = 0, or set reflectionFeeSell, marketingFeeSell, and teamFeeSell all to zero to make totalFeeSell = 0. Then execute a buy or sell transaction to trigger the division by zero in the fee calculation.
